replacements.en: Default to relationships first, contours discarded, adapting to the subject:
replacements.zh-CN: 默认采用“关系优先、轮廓舍弃”的抽象方式，但根据照片主体自适应处理：

replacements.en: Default to relationships first, but lean toward recognizability: when a subject has a distinctive form, use the upper end of the identity cues allowed below. Adapt to the subject:
replacements.zh-CN: 默认关系优先，但偏向可辨识：主体形状独特时，使用下文允许的身份特征上限。根据照片主体自适应处理：

replacements.en: Lean toward pure abstraction: keep relationships, discard contours, and use the lower end of the identity cues allowed below, or none when relationships alone are enough. Adapt to the subject:
replacements.zh-CN: 偏向纯粹抽象：保留关系、舍弃轮廓，使用下文允许的身份特征下限；仅凭关系已足够时可以不保留。根据照片主体自适应处理：

replacements.en:
Choose one primary family:

- Flat or slightly organic color blocks
- Soft circles or irregular masses
- Arcing or tapered strokes
- Continuous short bars or stacked color bands
- Simplified architectural masses
replacements.zh-CN:
主要标记可从以下形式中选择一种：

- 平面或微有机色块
- 柔和圆形或不规则质量
- 弧形或锥形笔触
- 连续短条或层叠色带
- 简化建筑质量

replacements.en: Use flat or slightly organic color blocks as the primary family.
replacements.zh-CN: 主要标记使用平面或微有机色块。

replacements.en: Use soft circles or irregular masses as the primary family.
replacements.zh-CN: 主要标记使用柔和圆形或不规则质量。

replacements.en: Use arcing or tapered strokes as the primary family.
replacements.zh-CN: 主要标记使用弧形或锥形笔触。

replacements.en: Use continuous short bars or stacked color bands as the primary family.
replacements.zh-CN: 主要标记使用连续短条或层叠色带。

replacements.en: Use simplified architectural masses as the primary family.
replacements.zh-CN: 主要标记使用简化建筑质量。

replacements.en:
Do not mechanically make the two sections equal in height. Adapt the proportion to the source image's orientation, subject density, visual center of gravity, and negative space:

- Landscape images or images with strong horizontal spread: photo area about 38%–52% of the final height; abstract panel about 48%–62%.
- Vertical architecture, people, or tall subjects: photo area about 55%–68%; abstract panel about 32%–45%.
- Near-square images or images with a balanced visual center: photo area about 48%–58%; abstract panel about 42%–52%.

Allow these proportions to shift by about 8% when needed; overall harmony takes precedence.
replacements.zh-CN:
不得机械地采用上下各占一半。应根据原照片方向、主体密度、视觉重心和留白状况，自适应决定拼接比例：

- 横向照片或具有强烈水平延展的照片：摄影区域约占成品高度的 38%–52%，抽象面板约占 48%–62%。
- 纵向建筑、人物或高耸主体照片：摄影区域约占 55%–68%，抽象面板约占 32%–45%。
- 接近方形或视觉重心均衡的照片：摄影区域约占 48%–58%，抽象面板约占 42%–52%。

以上比例允许根据实际画面上下浮动约 8%，以整体协调为最高原则。

replacements.en: Give the photograph more room: make the photo area about 58%–70% of the final height and the abstract panel about 30%–42%, adjusting slightly to the photo's orientation and subject.
replacements.zh-CN: 让照片占据更多空间：摄影区域约占成品高度的 58%–70%，抽象面板约占 30%–42%，并根据照片方向与主体略作调整。

replacements.en: Give the abstract panel more room: make the photo area about 36%–46% of the final height and the abstract panel about 54%–64%, adjusting slightly to the photo's orientation and subject.
replacements.zh-CN: 让抽象面板占据更多空间：摄影区域约占成品高度的 36%–46%，抽象面板约占 54%–64%，并根据照片方向与主体略作调整。

replacements.en: neutral ivory (#F3F0E8, or a harmonious color from the same family)
replacements.zh-CN: 中性象牙色（#F3F0E8，或与抽象母题搭配和谐的同色系颜色）

replacements.en: warm sand (#EDE3D1, or a harmonious color from the same family)
replacements.zh-CN: 暖沙色（#EDE3D1，或与抽象母题搭配和谐的同色系颜色）

replacements.en: soft mist gray (#E7E8E4, or a harmonious color from the same family)
replacements.zh-CN: 柔和雾灰色（#E7E8E4，或与抽象母题搭配和谐的同色系颜色）

replacements.en: pale sage (#E4E8DF, or a harmonious color from the same family)
replacements.zh-CN: 浅鼠尾草绿（#E4E8DF，或与抽象母题搭配和谐的同色系颜色）

replacements.en:
Default scale:

- Motif width: about 30%–42% of panel width.
- Motif height: normally no more than 28%–34% of panel height.
- Keep about 65%–80% clean white space.
replacements.zh-CN:
默认尺度：

- 母题占面板宽度约 30%–42%。
- 高度通常不超过面板高度的 28%–34%。
- 保留约 65%–80% 的干净空白。

replacements.en:
Default scale:

- Motif width: about 22%–32% of panel width.
- Motif height: normally no more than 20%–26% of panel height.
- Keep about 75%–88% clean white space.
replacements.zh-CN:
默认尺度：

- 母题占面板宽度约 22%–32%。
- 高度通常不超过面板高度的 20%–26%。
- 保留约 75%–88% 的干净空白。

replacements.en:
Default scale:

- Motif width: about 40%–55% of panel width.
- Motif height: normally no more than 34%–42% of panel height.
- Keep about 55%–68% clean white space.
replacements.zh-CN:
默认尺度：

- 母题占面板宽度约 40%–55%。
- 高度通常不超过面板高度的 34%–42%。
- 保留约 55%–68% 的干净空白。

replacements.en: At most one or two small accent colors
replacements.zh-CN: 最多一个至两个小面积强调色

replacements.en: At most one small accent color
replacements.zh-CN: 最多一个小面积强调色

replacements.en: No accent colors; stay with the three color roles above
replacements.zh-CN: 不使用强调色，只用以上三个色彩角色

replacements.en: Generate only one main title by default. Add a three-to-seven-word subtitle only if it adds a new layer of meaning rather than repeating the title.
replacements.zh-CN: 默认只生成一个主标题。仅当副标题能够增加新的语义层，而不是重复主标题时，才允许加入一个 3–7 个英文单词的短副标题。

replacements.en: Generate only one main title and no subtitle.
replacements.zh-CN: 只生成一个主标题，不加副标题。

replacements.en: Generate one main title plus a three-to-seven-word subtitle that adds a new layer of meaning rather than repeating the title.
replacements.zh-CN: 生成一个主标题，并加入一个能增加新语义层、而不重复主标题的 3–7 个英文单词短副标题。

replacements.en:
Adapt between these layouts:

1. Lower-left aligned. Use when the motif is centered toward the right, spreads horizontally, or the overall weight leans right. The title may be vertical or horizontal, with about 6%–9% safe distance from the left and lower edges.
2. Bottom centered. Use when the motif is essentially centered, the axis is clear, the architecture is symmetrical, or the image has a vertical echo. Align the title with the motif's central axis but do not place it too close to the motif.
replacements.zh-CN:
在以下两种布局中自适应选择：

1. 左下对齐：适用于母题居中偏右、横向延展或整体重心偏右的画面。此时标题可以考虑竖版或横板，标题距左边和底边保留约 6%–9% 的安全距离。
2. 底部居中：适用于母题基本居中、轴线明确、建筑对称或上下呼应的画面。标题与母题中心轴保持协调，但不要贴近母题。

replacements.en: Use a lower-left aligned layout. The title may be vertical or horizontal, with about 6%–9% safe distance from the left and lower edges.
replacements.zh-CN: 使用左下对齐布局。标题可以是竖版或横版，距左边和底边保留约 6%–9% 的安全距离。

replacements.en: Use a bottom-centered layout. Align the title with the motif's central axis but do not place it too close to the motif.
replacements.zh-CN: 使用底部居中布局。标题与母题中心轴保持协调，但不要贴近母题。
